# Estimating Functions Source Code


The R functions used throughout this book to compute point estimates, standard errors, and confidence intervals --- along with their `gt`-table formatting helpers --- are defined in a single shared file, `samplingestimate.r`, which every chapter sources. Its full source is listed below for reference.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat("```r\n")
cat(readLines("samplingestimate.r"), sep = "\n")
cat("\n```\n")
```
